Priya (CS): Heads-up — SummitRetail's Dedicated pool may hit quota during their promo next Wed. Forecast shows ~30% overcommit in the 11:00-13:00 ET window. Need a short mitigation plan: autoscale guardrail, temporary burst slots, 20m load run, and rollback steps. Volunteers?

Sam (Eng): I can do autoscale policy + fallback model. Suggest scale up when p95 > 250ms, max burst +35%. Will draft YAML and PR.

Omar (Infra): I can provision burst capacity once billing signs off. Need quota token and exact window. Zone constraints may apply.

Priya (CS): Quota token: SUM-2026-Q4. Window: Wed 11:00-13:00 ET (setup 10:30). Looping in @billing.

Rae (SRE): I'll author the rollback runbook (fast cutover to hosted fallback, disable autoscale ramp). Will include paging matrix and quick checks.

Tess (PDE): I'll run the 20m soak at 11:05 ET and post latency/error artefacts. Load profile: 6k RPS with mixed long/short. Using loadgen: 
```bash
./loadgen --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --rps 6000 --duration 1200 --profile profiles/summit.json --auth "Bearer $SUM_TOKEN"
```
I'll capture KV cache hit rate and tails.

ops-bot: Scheduled job -> load-summit-1725560100. CI: https://ci.internal/steps/lt-summit-1725560100 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Omar (Infra): Billing approved provisional burst Wed 10:30-13:30 ET. I'll provision and publish slot IDs today.

Sam (Eng): Draft autoscale snippet I'll PR:
```yaml
autoscale:
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  scale_up_threshold: 250
  scale_down_threshold: 120
  cool_down: 90s
  max_burst_percent: 35
  fallback_model: small-quant-v1
```

Rae (SRE): Runbook draft link: https://confluence.internal/summit/dedicated-preflight. Quick rollback commands: 
```bash
redwood route update --customer summit --pool default
redwood autoscale update --customer summit --enabled false
```

Priya (CS): Owners recap: Sam -> autoscale PR (EOD); Omar -> slots & IDs (EOD); Tess -> load run Wed 11:05 ET; Rae -> runbook final (Mon EOD); Priya -> customer comms + renewals note. Reconvene Tue 16:00 ET for go/no-go.

Sam (Eng): +1 :thumbsup:

Tess (PDE): Will post artifacts here after staging shadow run.

ops-bot: Reminder -> load-summit-1725560100 in 24h.

Priya (CS): Note: log anomalies to ticket SUM-4567 and escalate to #incidents if 5xx spikes.
